text:
zoe (PM): dropping a short design review for the Invite + Roles panel update: https://www.figma.com/file/example. Top questions: SSO toggle location (header vs org panel), dense roles row actions (hover vs persistent), and a fast path to audit events (Audit Finder). Any blockers? :eyes:
drew (Designer): pushed a compact variant with a right-aligned micro-kebab (always visible, low contrast). Hover-only felt too hidden in research.
kai (Frontend): prefer persistent micro-kebab. Hover-only caused reflow on Safari last time. Implementation idea: fixed-width action column to avoid layout shift. Touch targets must remain >=44px.
maria (Eng): accessibility: micro-kebab must be focusable with aria-label (e.g., "Row actions for <member>"). Role chips should use aria-pressed/aria-selected and announce state: "Role: Billing Admin, assigned". Also require visible focus rings on compressed rows.
luis (Support): from tickets customers often ask where audit logs lived after UI changes. Strong +1 for a persistent Audit icon in header + optional timestamp anchors in rows that open Audit Finder. Also request a confirmation when enabling org-level SSO.
a11y-bot: quick checklist: 1) SSO toggle: aria-checked + aria-describedby for helper text. 2) roles grid: semantic table or labeled list. 3) micro-kebab: keyboard reachable, aria-expanded on open. 4) Audit Finder: labelled dialog, focus trap, and a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+K) entry.
drew (Designer): copy tweak suggestion: "Invite people" instead of "Invite team"; change SSO label to "Enforce SSO sign-in" with helper text "blocks non-SSO logins". I'll try short label + helper in header.
kai (Frontend): we'll wire aria-describedby for helper copy so SRs get full context without breaking layout. For timestamp anchors: route param `/orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_1234` with a graceful fallback (toast/tooltip) if audit not enabled.
maria (Eng): i'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass on updated frames once posted. target Tue EOD.
zoe (PM): thanks all 44d. next steps: drew update figma with micro-kebab + audit icon + copy variants; kai spike anchor + fallback + touch sizing; maria a11y pass; luis draft KB for SSO confirmation and Audit Finder. reconvene Thu morning.
